about: Per-world limits (#4013 follow-up, #1960). Keyed by the world's slug, which the machine's world-authority map (/etc/souls/placement-data/authority.json) turns into its placed instance. install.sh apply writes worldd@<instance>.service.d/limits.conf from it (world-limits.mjs); a world not listed keeps worldd@.service's own limits (MemoryMax=2G) and deploy's 30 s start bound. memory_max: a systemd MemoryMax (digits then M or G). start_within_s: how long deploy's rehearsal and canary wait for the world to serve (1 to 3600). Runbook: v2/docs/runbook/world-restarting.md.
